evidence.observation: Tube pressure gauge is not installed; growth requires pressure verification.
Pressure remains null, so the required growth atmosphere cannot be verified.
Exhaust oxygen was 7.3 ppm before growth.
Oxygen has risen progressively during growth to 44.7 ppm; this is concerning but does not identify a specific fault.
Temperature of 750.3 °C and argon flow of 99.9 sccm track their setpoints, but do not establish acceptable tube pressure.

args.missing_evidence: A valid tube-pressure measurement, growth pressure and O2 acceptance limits, and investigation of the increasing oxygen signal are needed to verify execution; sample characterization is needed to assess growth.
